actions.action: SIX successive natural walking phases facing straight SOUTH toward viewer. Left contact, passing right foot forward, left push off, right contact, passing left foot forward, right push off. Low-amplitude opposite arm swing, balanced weight, one foot supports body each phase. Sword remains safely carried low in right hand, away from legs, blade never intersects limbs. No running, no hopping.
actions.prompt: Create a SMALL, carefully aligned pixel-art game animation atlas using the reference male Thai warrior identity. Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, equal SQUARE cells, 6 poses in reading order left to right then next row. SIX successive natural walking phases facing straight SOUTH toward viewer. Left contact, passing right foot forward, left push off, right contact, passing left foot forward, right push off. Low-amplitude opposite arm swing, balanced weight, one foot supports body each phase. Sword remains safely carried low in right hand, away from legs, blade never intersects limbs. No running, no hopping. ONE character per cell, same face, indigo Thai clothes, red sash, brass shoulder/forearm armor, dark boots, same short black hair and daab sword. Low top-down camera same as reference. Keep all head, elbows, fingers, knees, feet and entire sword well INSIDE each cell with at least 12% clear transparent padding on ALL sides. Character standing height is ONLY 55% of cell height to leave room for sword swing. Standing sole ground line at 78% cell height, pelvis x at50%, same scale across cells. Do NOT enlarge individual poses to fill their cell. Transparent background, no shadows, no lines, labels, text or scenery. Accurate joints, no duplicate limbs, no extra swords. Crisp pixel art matching reference. Canvas ratio 3:2. Natural animation and generous padding are more important than fine ornament.

Do not rotate to side profile. Clear action with no spinning.
